scope:
Measure exported R2 tooth profiles, axial engagement and rigid backlash.

Tooth sections are sampled from exported BReps at <=0.02 mm along each edge. This is a
nominal, rigid geometry analysis, not a force/contact-ratio or print test.

design.note: Matched involute working flanks; radial relief below base circle and 0.10 mm root fillets. Retain original hubs, bores and big-gear arm junctions. Nominal backlash is a CAD value, not a printed tolerance guarantee.
